# Manage usage and limits

The API endpoints described in this section return your account's usage for the current monthly cycle and let you view and update your account limits.

For details, see the [Limits](https://docs.apify.com/account/limits).

<!-- -->

## [Get monthly usage](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-usage-monthly-get.md)

[/users/me/usage/monthly](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-usage-monthly-get.md)

## [Get limits](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-limits-get.md)

[/users/me/limits](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-limits-get.md)

## [Update limits](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-limits-put.md)
